author: hbinhng
body:
Adds a third dispatch branch in State::from_input: when input is the single dash, read the spec from stdin via tokio::io::stdin and parse through the existing serde_yaml pipeline (handles both YAML and JSON). Enables pipelines like:

  curl -fsSL https://example.com/openapi.json | openapi-tui --input -
  cat petstore.json | openapi-tui --input -

If stdin is a TTY (user typed `openapi-tui --input -` without piping), bail with a clear error rather than silently waiting for the user to type a full spec + Ctrl-D. Empty input also surfaces a clear error.

`openapi_input_source` is set to `<stdin>` for display purposes. The CLI help text is updated to mention the dash form.

Crossterm reads keys from /dev/tty directly on Unix, so the stdin pipe used for the spec doesn't conflict with keyboard input.

author: lws0331
body:
## Why

Item 1 from the post-batch follow-up list. Three bugs in two weeks from the same root cause:

| PR | Where it dropped |
|---|---|
| #153 | client body + server allow-list both missed `macroCycles` (write) |
| #155 | provision route omitted `isJunior` / `juniorAge` / `parentIds` (provision) |
| #163 | GET projection omitted `macroCycles` (read) |

Pattern: hand-picked allowlist of ~30 fields that drifts from the Prisma schema. Every new column on `Operator` requires somebody to remember to add it. **Three separate times nobody did**, the data round-tripped through this route, and quietly disappeared on the client.

## The fix

Inverted: spread the whole row, then DELETE the credentials that must never leak. New schema columns ride through automatically. The denylist is small + auditable + the security invariant is explicit-in-code rather than implicit-by-omission.

```ts
const operators = rows.map(row => {
  const { pin, passwordHash, googleId, ...safe } = row;
  return safe;
});
```

### Denylist rationale

- `pin` — login credential (PIN-based entry surface)
- `passwordHash` — bcrypt; never client-visible
- `googleId` — OAuth subject id; not needed client-side and reveals Google identity

If a future column ALSO must not leak (API tokens, billing PII, third-party refresh tokens, etc.) — one obvious place to add it.

## What's NOT in this PR

- The `/api/operators/[id]/profile` PATCH route still has an allow-list. That's correct for writes — we want to gate which fields a client can update. Reads (this route) are different: omitting a field on read is a silent bug, not a security feature.
- The `/api/operators/[id]/workouts` PATCH route has its own narrow allow-list (workouts / prs / dayTags / injuries). Also correct.
- The `operator-provision` route (PR #155) was fixed in-place to write the missing fields explicitly. Could be reshaped to spread the seed too — flagged as a follow-on if you want one less divergence point.

## Test plan

- [ ] After merge + deploy: hard-refresh any operator's page (Cmd+Shift+R / PWA reopen) → all expected fields still present (callsign, tier, intake, profile, workouts, sitrep, macroCycles, sport profile, etc.)
- [ ] Network tab: GET /api/operators response should NOT include `pin`, `passwordHash`, or `googleId` for any operator
- [ ] Test as: admin (sees all rows), trainer (sees self + clients), client (sees self + linked juniors + trainers), parent (sees junior via parentIds expansion)

body: ## 概述 对整个仓库（云函数 + 小程序前端）做了严谨 review，并修复发现的全部问题。共 5 个 commit、按层次拆分，便于回看： 1. `fix(cloudfunctions): 修正 getMatchCandidates 价格边界精度并校验基准价` 2. `fix(miniprogram): 加固 cloud.init 占位识别并统一封装 callFunction 错误` 3. `fix(login,profile): 登录失败安全降级；错误信息空值兜底；profile 加载态与编辑取消` 4. `fix(items): 修正 detail 内层 wx:for 变量冲突；增强 list/create UI 与表单校验` 5. `fix(match): 修复 swipe getter bug；新增手势滑动与回赞/忽略；统一错误兜底` ## Review 发现并修复的问题 ### A. 云函数（cloudfunctions/） - **`getMatchCandidates` 价格边界精度问题** 原写法 `Number((baseItem.price * 0.9).toFixed(2))` 会先四舍五入到 2 位小数再当成边界，导致与 `recordSwipe` 中按 `abs(diff)/base <= 0.1` 的精确判断不一致，边界候选可能"前端能看到但点 like 被后端拒绝"。改为直接用 `basePrice * 0.9`、`basePrice * 1.1` 作为 DB `>=` / `<=` 边界；并在基准价非法（0 或非数）时直接返回错误，避免除零产生 NaN。同时把 `baseItem` 一并返回供前端展示。 ### B. 小程序底层（utils + services） - **`utils/cloud.js`**： - 占位 envId 识别更鲁棒（trim、空字符串、`your-cloud-env-id` 都视为占位）。 - 新增 `ensureCloud()`，在每次调用云函数前兜底初始化，避免 onLaunch 失败导致全程白屏。 - `wx.cloud.init` 失败返回 false，让上层可见错误。 - **`services/api.js`**： - 网络/平台错误也封装成统一 `Error`（带 `code`），杜绝 `error.message` 为 undefined 让上层 `.includes()` 抛 TypeError。 - 业务错误（`success:false`）保留 `message` + `code`。 ### C. 页面层（pages/） - **`pages/login/index`** - 修复登录跳转：`wx.switchTab` 失败时降级到 `wx.reLaunch`，保证目标可达。 - **`wx.getUserProfile` 失败安全降级**：用户拒绝/新基础库禁用时不再阻断登录，云函数会用默认昵称建档。 - 加 `loading` 防重复点击；登录 openid 写入本地 storage 便于复用。 - **`pages/profile/index`** - `error.message.includes(...)` 当 `message` 为 undefined 会抛 TypeError 掩盖原错误，改为安全 `String(error?.message || "")`。 - 加 loading 占位、头像 placeholder、字数计数、"取消编辑"按钮、点击物品跳转 detail。 - 显示 `matchedCount` 等附加字段。 - **`pages/items/index`** - 加下拉刷新、空状态发布按钮、`status` 彩色徽标、tags 渲染。 - 错误信息空值兜底。 - **`pages/items/create`** - 价格输入加正则约束（只允许数字与 1 位小数点、最多 2 位小数）。 - 图片上传按 openid 分目录、加上扩展名兜底、按 `Promise.all` 并发上传。 - 校验信息细化（图片数、描述长度、tags 个数、单 tag 长度、价格 > 0）。 - 提交按钮禁用态、提交中文案。 - **`pages/items/detail`** - **修复 wxml 变量冲突**：原 `` 与 `` 内层默认变量名 `item` 覆盖外层 Page data 的 `item`，引发歧义；改用 `wx:for-item="imgUrl"` / `"tag"` 显式重命名。 - 加 swiper 点击预览大图、isOwner 判断后才显示"去匹配 / 查看喜欢我的"。 - 错误信息空值兜底；缺参直接返回。 - **`pages/match/swipe`** - **修复 `get currentCandidate()` getter bug**：原代码把 getter 写在 Page 配置对象上，框架在 Page 注册时枚举属性会"取一次值"（candidates 还没初始化所以是 null）然后挂到实例上，后续 `this.currentCandidate` 永远是 null，导致 `handleSwipe` 一进来就 return，匹配按钮完全失效。改为普通函数 `currentCandidate()`。 - 新增**手势卡片滑动**：左右拖拽超阈值触发 dislike/like，含动画与 like/dislike badge；保留按钮触发模式。 - 加 progress 计数、空候选刷新与返回、busy 防重复。 - **`pages/match/incoming`** - 新增"忽略"按钮（对应 `respondIncomingLike` 的 dislike），不会让"我不喜欢"的请求一直占着列表。 - 卡片信息更完整（昵称、信用、状态徽标、价格、跳转 detail）。 - 错误信息空值兜底；防重复点击。 ## PRD 验收口径对齐 PRD §3.1～§3.4 的全部校验都已经在云函数和前端表单两层做了： - 1–9 张图、1–200 字描述、≤10 个 tag、单 tag ≤12 字、价格 > 0 - 价格差 ≤10%（前后端边界完全一致） - 双向 like 自动写 `matches`、状态变 `matched`、`matchedCount +1` - 信用等级 A/B/C/D 由云函数统一计算 ## 校验 - `node --check` 全部 `.js`（包括小程序业务脚本与 10 个云函数）均通过 - 所有 `.json`（页面 json、`app.json`、`package.json`、`project.config.json`、`sitemap.json`）均 `JSON.parse` 通过 - WXML 内层 `wx:for` 变量名冲突已逐一排查 ## 部署验证（未变） 仍按 `docs/deploy-and-verify.md` 执行：初始化 4 个集合、按 `docs/cloudbase-indexes.md` 建索引、按 `docs/cloudbase-security-rules.jsonc` 配权限、依次部署 10 个云函数。

body:
## Summary

Follow-up to #14. The inline-review POST is in fact reaching GitHub and being rejected with HTTP 422, but the previous run logs only showed `gh: Unprocessable Entity (HTTP 422)` — gh's compact error message strips the JSON body that tells us *which* comment is invalid (the usual cause is a `line` that isn't part of the diff hunk on the chosen `side`).

This PR adds diagnostics so the next 422 is actionable:

- Replace `gh api --method POST` with a direct `curl` so the full response body is preserved verbatim and printed when the status is non-2xx.
- Before posting, log `comments[].{path,line,side,start_line,start_side}` from the payload so we can correlate the rejected entry with what Claude actually anchored.
- Comment-only fallback path is unchanged.

Once we see a real 422 body, we'll know whether the fix is in the prompt (better diff-position rules), in pre-validation (filter Claude's anchors against the actual diff hunks before posting), or both.

## Summary
This PR fixes URL handling in the product-info component to correctly manage query parameters when switching between products in combined listings and when selecting variants. The changes ensure that canonical URLs remain clean while preserving necessary variant information in the address bar.

## Key Changes

- **Pathname-only comparison for product detection**: Changed product comparison logic to compare only the pathname portion of URLs, ignoring query parameters. This prevents false positives when `data-product-url` contains `?variant=ID` parameters.

- **Simplified combined listing navigation**: For combined listings, the component now directly navigates to the target product URL without appending `option_values` parameters, ensuring the canonical URL stays clean (`/products/<child>?variant=<id>`).

- **Improved URL parameter handling**: Refactored `buildRequestUrlWithParams()` to use the `URL` and `URLSearchParams` APIs instead of string concatenation. This correctly preserves existing query parameters (like `?variant=<id>`) instead of producing malformed URLs with multiple `?` characters.

- **Canonical-friendly URL updates**: Enhanced `updateURL()` to strip fetch-only parameters (`option_values`, `section_id`) from the address bar while preserving only the `?variant=<id>` parameter. This keeps the canonical tag clean at `/products/<handle>` while the address bar shows the variant selection.

- **Product gallery integration**: Added explicit notification to custom `<product-gallery>` elements when media needs to be updated, since the component is separate from the default `<media-gallery>` path.

## Implementation Details

- Uses `URL` constructor with `window.location.origin` as base to safely parse and manipulate URLs
- Leverages `URLSearchParams` for clean parameter management
- Maintains backward compatibility with existing product form behavior
- Improves code readability with descriptive variable names (`isDifferentProduct`, `basePath`, `targetPath`) replacing single-letter variables

### Issue

Closes #37797.

### Reason for this change

`LogGroup.addToResourcePolicy()` converted IAM ARN principals to bare AWS account IDs before synthesizing the CloudWatch Logs resource policy. CloudFormation accepts that form, but stores the principal canonically as `arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::<account>:root`, which causes drift detection to report a persistent false positive.

### Description of changes

This changes the conversion to use `iam.AccountPrincipal`, so ARN principals are reduced to canonical account root ARN principals instead of bare account IDs. The existing log group tests now assert the synthesized policy document uses the account root ARN form, including the tokenized imported-role-ARN case.

### Description of how you validated changes

- `yarn --cwd packages/aws-cdk-lib test aws-logs/test/loggroup.test.ts --runInBand --coverage=false`
- `yarn --cwd packages/aws-cdk-lib test aws-logs/test/policy.test.ts --runInBand --coverage=false`

## Summary

Installs RKE2 on top of the do-test substrate -- 3-CP HA cluster + 3 workers -- via Ansible. Introduces the Ansible scaffolding the rest of the repo will reuse: roles, playbooks, inventory generator, SOPS-encrypted tokens, autossh-based operator kube tunnel.

Closes #6.

Design lives in-repo: [`openspec/changes/add-rke2-install/`](https://github.com/geekmush/rke2-demo/tree/feat/rke2-install/openspec/changes/add-rke2-install).

## What's in it

| Layer | Resource | Path |
|---|---|---|
| Tofu | `digitalocean_loadbalancer` (network = INTERNAL) | `terraform/modules/do-droplet-infra/loadbalancer.tf` |
| Ansible | `rke2_common` role (idempotent OS prereqs) | `ansible/roles/rke2_common/` |
| Ansible | `rke2_server` role (install + bootstrap-vs-join + kubeconfig) | `ansible/roles/rke2_server/` |
| Ansible | `rke2_agent` role (install + join) | `ansible/roles/rke2_agent/` |
| Ansible | `playbooks/site.yml` (serial: 1 CPs + parallel workers) | `ansible/playbooks/site.yml` |
| Ansible | `render-inventory.py` (`tofu output -json` -> Ansible YAML) | `ansible/scripts/render-inventory.py` |
| Ansible | `kube-tunnel.sh` (autossh wrapper with CP rotation) | `ansible/scripts/kube-tunnel.sh` |
| Docs | RKE2 install runbook + topology diagram + README pointer | `docs/runbooks/rke2-install.md`, `docs/diagrams/rke2-topology.md`, `README.md` |

## Decisions worth a second look

1. **LB is INTERNAL, not EXTERNAL.** First design had an EXTERNAL LB with an operator-managed public-CIDR allowlist. That broke because DO LBs preserve client source IP when forwarding TCP -- droplet-side firewall (per CLAUDE.md "RKE2 inter-node ports VPC-internal only") drops LB-forwarded traffic. Switching to INTERNAL keeps the access model intact, and the LB stays useful forever for CP-to-CP and worker join traffic. Operator kube access pre-Twingate is via SSH tunnel; the application ingress LB is a separate Phase 3 resource.
2. **Cluster + service CIDRs pinned to 10.244.0.0/16 / 10.245.0.0/16.** RKE2's defaults overlap the existing nyc3 default VPC at 10.42.0.0/20. DO refuses to delete or demote a default VPC, so we move the CIDRs instead. Documented inline in `inventory/group_vars/all/main.yml` and in the design doc.
3. **`group_vars/` lives under `ansible/inventory/`**, not at the ansible/ root. Ansible's `host_group_vars` plugin resolves them relative to the inventory file.
4. **`community.sops.sops` `valid_extensions` widened to `.enc.*`** so the plugin picks up this repo's existing naming convention instead of its default `.sops.*`.
5. **Kubeconfig destination uses `{{ playbook_dir }}/../artifacts/kubeconfig`** so the file lands in `ansible/artifacts/` regardless of where ansible-playbook is invoked from. The default relative-path resolution from `playbooks/` would put it in `ansible/playbooks/artifacts/`.

## Commit series

| # | Commit | Scope |
|---|--------|-------|
| 1 | `docs(openspec): propose add-rke2-install` | OpenSpec proposal + design + tasks (42 numbered tasks) |
| 2 | `feat(terraform): add internal CP load balancer` | Reusable LB resource + cp_endpoint output |
| 3 | `feat(ansible): scaffold layout, render-inventory, SOPS-encrypted tokens` | ansible.cfg, requirements, Makefile, inventory generator, group_vars, tokens |
| 4 | `feat(ansible): add rke2_common role` | Idempotent OS-prereq replay |
| 5 | `feat(ansible): add rke2_server role + bootstrap-vs-join + kubeconfig` | The meatiest role |
| 6 | `feat(ansible): add rke2_agent role` | Worker join |
| 7 | `feat(ansible): site.yml playbook orchestrating bring-up` | Serial CPs + parallel workers |
| 8 | `feat(ansible): operator kube-tunnel script (autossh wrapper)` | SSH tunnel through any healthy CP |
| 9 | `docs: RKE2 install runbook, topology diagram, README pointer` | groundrule #7 docs |

## Verification

End-to-end against the live do-test cluster:

```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide
NAME                  STATUS   ROLES                AGE     VERSION          INTERNAL-IP
rke2-demo-cp-01       Ready    control-plane,etcd   9m36s   v1.35.4+rke2r1   10.42.0.39
rke2-demo-cp-02       Ready    control-plane,etcd   8m5s    v1.35.4+rke2r1   10.42.0.38
rke2-demo-cp-03       Ready    control-plane,etcd   6m44s   v1.35.4+rke2r1   10.42.0.37
rke2-demo-worker-01   Ready    <none>               5m51s   v1.35.4+rke2r1   10.42.0.40

rke2-demo-worker-03   Ready    <none>               5m54s   v1.35.4+rke2r1   10.42.0.35
```

`kubectl get pods -A` shows no `CrashLoopBackOff`. Three etcd pods Ready in `kube-system`. A second `make -C ansible play` reports `changed=0` on every host except the kubeconfig task (mode/path may differ on operator workstations).

## Out of scope (deliberate)

- No Rancher, Longhorn, FluxCD.
- No application-ingress LB (Phase 3 resource).
- No `ansible-lint` enforcement here -- runs locally via `make lint`, no CI workflow exists yet.
- No `--check --diff` smoke test as a task; will revisit with a generic CI strategy.

## Summary

Reshape `docker-compose.prod.yml` (+ a handful of `docker/` files)
for the production deployment topology managed by our IaC repo. No
app-code, schema, or dependency changes — entirely deployment.

- **Stub redis + mariadb to busybox.** Both run natively on the DB
  tier reached over a private network; the local containers exist
  only so the base compose's `depends_on` graph keeps merging
  cleanly without publishing 3306/6379 on the host.
- **Parameterize `REDIS_URL` / `ARQ_REDIS_URL`** so the api + worker
  read the real values from `.env.prod` instead of the hardcoded
  `redis://redis:6379/...` they used when redis was in-stack.
- **Re-enable `nginx` + `certbot` containers** (previously
  `profiles: [disabled]`) — nginx terminates TLS for `NGINX_HOST`,
  certbot loops `renew` every 12h via the dns-cloudflare plugin.
  New `cloudflare-real-ip.conf` translates `CF-Connecting-IP` →
  `$remote_addr` so backend logs see actual visitor IPs.
- **Add `mediawiki` container** (`mediawiki:1.45`) for the wiki
  subdomain. `LocalSettings.php` and the `mediawiki-images` volume
  are populated by the IaC layer; legacy `/wiki/*` paths on the
  apex 301 to the wiki subdomain (hardcoded in
  `frontend-production.conf.template`).
- **Broker docker.sock to alloy via `tecnativa/docker-socket-proxy`.**
  Alloy stays under userns-remap and reads container metadata over
  TCP on an internal `socket-proxy-net`. Allowlist is
  `CONTAINERS=1 NETWORKS=1` only (read-only); the proxy's the only
  thing with host-level docker access. Drops the prior pattern of
  alloy holding `docker` group via hardcoded gid.
- **Ingress posture tightening**: drop host publishes from
  meilisearch, internal-only alloy/loki, ports-published nginx is
  the only externally-reachable service.
- **`!override env_file` on api + arq-worker** to drop the dev-only
  `.env` file from the merge so prod doesn't error when it's
  absent.

## Compatibility with the current prod host

These changes target the new deployment topology — they do **not**
stay compatible with the current production host:

- Stubbing redis loses the existing in-stack redis container.
- Removing the LAN MariaDB entry from `extra_hosts` breaks the
  current path to MariaDB.
- nginx/certbot containers conflict with the existing host-level
  nginx + certbot.
- `DOCKER_GID` env var is required (rendered by the IaC layer into
  `.env.prod` on the new host); the current host's `.env.prod`
  doesn't define it.

Plan is for the current host to stay on `main` until the apex
cutover, then this branch lands as the new authoritative compose.
Rollback during cutover works because the legacy host continues
running `main` (no schema or app-code drift between this branch
and `main`).

## Test plan

- [x] IaC `compose_project` role renders `.env.prod` with
      `DOCKER_GID`, `REDIS_URL`, `ARQ_REDIS_URL`, `NGINX_HOST`
- [x] `docker compose up -d` brings up nginx + certbot + alloy +
      socket-proxy + mediawiki cleanly
- [x] certbot DNS-01 issuance via cloudflare credentials
- [x] alloy discovery via socket-proxy emits container logs to loki
      (no docker group required)
- [x] Wiki subdomain resolves through nginx → mediawiki container →
      MariaDB
- [x] api reaches MariaDB + redis over the private network
- [x] Legacy `/wiki/*` URLs on staging 301 to the wiki subdomain

## What changed
- `scripts/fetch_runtime_dev.py:_safe_extract` — two-pass extraction: regular files first, link entries (sym + hard) second.
- `scripts/fetch_runtime_dev.py:_flatten_archive_top_dir` — content-aware collision policy: identical bytes silently skipped, content-different collisions refused.

## Why
Codex's inline review on #597 flagged two reliability nits:

### [P2] Hardlink ordering
`tarfile.extract()` raises `KeyError: 'linkname'` when a hardlink is processed before its referenced file. tar archives are not required to order link entries after their target — the v0.1.10 darwin tarball happens to use symlinks (which the kernel creates without resolving the target, so order doesn't matter), but a future stt or x86_64 darwin tarball could ship hardlinks and crash mid-extraction.

### [P2] Silent flatten overwrite
`_flatten_archive_top_dir` was copying files into `target_path` via `shutil.copy2` without checking whether `target_path` already existed. A malicious wrapper could silently clobber a sibling tarball's LICENSE, NOTICE, SHA256SUMS, etc.

## How it works

### Two-pass extraction
Split members into `members_regular` and `members_links` during the validation pass. Extract regular files first, then link entries. Symlinks don't need the ordering but go through the same path for code simplicity.

### Collision policy
- **Identical bytes** → silently skipped. This is the expected v0.1.10 darwin shape: both the headers tarball and the bin tarball ship `include/octomil/runtime.h` from the same tag.
- **Different bytes** → refused with `error: ... (content differs)`. Closes the malicious-clobber path.

## Testing
- 44/44 tests pass (4 new regression tests):
  - hardlink before target in archive order (locks the ordering fix)
  - flatten refuses content-different collision (CVE-shape regression)
  - flatten silently skips content-identical collision (expected v0.1.10 darwin shape)
  - flatten merges directories without collision (legitimate include/ merge)
- Live darwin smoke against v0.1.10:
  ```
  fetching octomil-runtime v0.1.10 (chat/darwin-arm64)
    manifest found: v0.1.10 ABI {'major': 0, 'minor': 10, 'patch': 0}
    download ...
  runtime ready: ~/.cache/.../v0.1.10/chat/lib/liboctomil-runtime.dylib
  ```
- ruff + mypy clean.

## Checklist
- [x] 44/44 tests pass
- [x] Live darwin smoke succeeds (legitimate identical-bytes runtime.h overlap)
- [x] New regression tests pin both fixes
- [x] No regressions in existing _safe_extract security guards
- [x] Addresses Codex inline comments on #597 (lines 333 + 363)

### Motivation
- Twilio webhooks POST `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` but the mounted webhooks router relied on global `express.json()`, leaving `req.body` empty and causing inbound calls to fall through to voicemail and signature validation to fail.

### Description
- Import `express` into `src/routes/webhooks.ts` and add router-level `router.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: false }))` so Twilio form-encoded payloads are parsed before middleware and handlers.
- Add sentinel `BF_SERVER_BLOCK_v324_TWILIO_WEBHOOKS_URLENCODED_BODY_v1` and explanatory comments describing the root cause and the rationale for `extended: false`.

### Testing
- Verified the sentinel line with `grep -F "BF_SERVER_BLOCK_v324_TWILIO_WEBHOOKS_URLENCODED_BODY_v1" src/routes/webhooks.ts`.
- Verified the new parser middleware with `grep -F "router.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: false }))" src/routes/webhooks.ts`.
- Ran `npx tsc --noEmit`, which surfaced pre-existing repository-wide type/dependency errors unrelated to this one-file change and did not indicate problems introduced by this patch.

## Summary

ADR-003 Phase C 実装。auth-worker 側の stub fallback (ippoan/auth-worker#135) で `cc_relay_ping` が出るようになった上に、本 PR で実 binary を WS 接続させて relay として動かす。

## What changed

### `agent-mcp::relay` (新モジュール)

- `RelayConfig` + `RelayServer` + `run()`
- `wss://mcp(-staging).ippoan.org/connect` に outbound WS 張る (Bearer JWT 付き、device-flow trip で取った token を使う)
- `hello` frame 送出 → 以降 `req` frame を pump
- 受信 frame の `body_b64` (JSON-RPC 2.0) を hand-rolled dispatcher で処理 → `resp` frame で返す
- frame schema は `auth-worker/src/durable_objects/mcp-session-do.ts` と完全互換 (`kind/v/id/status/headers/body_b64`)

### Dispatcher

| Method | 動作 |
|---|---|
| `initialize` | `protocolVersion`/`capabilities`/`serverInfo`。`params.protocolVersion` を echo (string 以外 fallback `2025-06-18`) |
| `notifications/*` (id 不在/null) | `Ok(None)` → caller が 202 Accepted 返す |
| `tools/list` | `cc_relay_list_agents` 1 個 |
| `tools/call cc_relay_list_agents` | `Broker::list_agents()` → JSON text content |
| `tools/call` 不明 | -32602 |
| `ping` / `prompts/list` / `resources/list` | 空 result |
| 不明 method / method 欠落 | -32601 |
| malformed JSON | -32700 |
| non-object body | -32600 |

auth-worker 側の inline stub と wire 互換なので、connector からは「どちら側が応答したか」が透過。

### CLI

`rust-mcp-agent relay` 新サブコマンド:

```
rust-mcp-agent relay \
  --broker-repo ippoan/cc-relay \
  --broker-issue 35 \
  --broker-token <pat> \
  [--ws-url wss://mcp-staging.ippoan.org/connect] \
  [--token-path ~/.cc-relay/token]
```

`~/.cc-relay/token` (`rust-mcp-agent auth` で書かれる cache) から JWT 読み出し、長期常駐。

## Tracks

- ippoan/cc-relay#37 (ADR-003 Phase F acceptance)
- ARCHITECTURE.md ADR-003 Phase C / D phase mapping
- 直前: ippoan/auth-worker#133 #134 #135

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo test --workspace` — 全 crate green。`agent-mcp::relay` の dispatcher に 16 ケース新設 (initialize variants, 各 method 分岐, malformed body, notification id-undefined/null, broker error 伝播)
- [x] `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` clean
- [x] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` clean
- [ ] staging で `rust-mcp-agent relay` 起動 + Anthropic 側で `cc_relay_list_agents` を呼んで実 broker tool が動くことを確認

## Out of scope (follow-ups)

- **Phase D**: JWT refresh on expiry (current TTL 1h、過ぎたら手動再起動)、WS 切断時の reconnect。`TokenManager` 配線が必要
- 実 broker tools 全部 (`notify_agent`, `claim_task`, `update_task`, `fetch_since`, plan ops)
- rmcp 統合 (現 hand-rolled は意図的選択。rmcp transport が WS frame の req/resp shape にハマらない)
- `docs/credentials.md` 更新 (Phase E)
- prod cutover (`mcp.ippoan.org`) (Phase G)

## Why hand-rolled dispatcher

rmcp の `StreamableHttpService` は HTTP transport を前提としていて、WS frame の req/resp 形を内側に通すには custom transport を書く必要がある。それ書くより最小 dispatcher 直書きの方が小さく、auth-worker 側 stub と shape を揃えられて運用上もデバッグしやすい。実 tools が増えてきて schema/validation コストが嵩んだら rmcp 移行検討。

## Escopo

  Implementação do pareamento real entre Sessionux Agent e Sessionux Mobile via QR Code, com geração do QR no Agent, captura pelo Mobile, persistência do vínculo e compatibilidade com Expo Go para o fluxo de pareamento.

  ## Tarefa

  TAREFA-000 (TODO)

  ## Descrição

  ### Adicionado

  - Geração de QR Code real no Agent com payload de pareamento válido.
  - Captura real de QR Code no Mobile usando expo-camera.
  - Serviço PairingService para completar o pareamento com o Agent e salvar o vínculo local.
  - Persistência do pareamento e chaves no Mobile usando módulos Expo compatíveis com Expo Go.
  - Testes para scanner, pareamento, biometria e discovery.
  - ADR documentando a decisão por ZeroConf/mDNS e sua limitação no Expo Go.

  ### Modificado

  - Ajustado o fluxo do Mobile para completar o pareamento via POST /pairing/complete.
  - Migrada a geração de chave Ed25519 para usar expo-crypto.
  - Migrado o armazenamento local de react-native-keychain para expo-secure-store.
  - Ajustado o fluxo biométrico para usar expo-local-authentication.
  - Ajustado o discovery para degradar sem crash quando react-native-zeroconf não estiver disponível no Expo Go.
  - Melhorado o tratamento de erros de pareamento para diferenciar erro de rede, erro de storage, erro de chave e erro do servidor.

  ### Corrigido

  - Corrigida a renderização do QR Code no Agent.
  - Corrigida a falha do Mobile no Expo Go causada por react-native-vision-camera/NitroModules.
  - Corrigida a falha do Mobile no Expo Go causada por react-native-keychain.
  - Corrigida a falha de geração de chave causada por globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues indisponível.
  - Corrigido o crash de discovery causado por binding nativo ausente do ZeroConf no Expo Go.
  - Corrigido alerta de erro de rede mascarando falhas locais de chave/storage.

  ### Removido

  - Removido uso de react-native-vision-camera no fluxo de captura de QR.
  - Removido uso de react-native-keychain no runtime do Mobile.
  - Removidos caminhos que dependiam de módulos nativos incompatíveis com Expo Go para o pareamento.

  ## Observações

  Validações executadas:

  - sessionux-agent: npm run check:all aprovado.
  - sessionux-mobile: npm run check:all aprovado.
  - Mobile: 9 arquivos de teste e 53 testes aprovados.

body:
Closes #90.

## What changed
- Deleted `.github/workflows/tests.yml`.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is now the single source of truth for pytest on PRs and pushes to `main`.
- Added `cache: pip` to `setup-python` (the one useful step `tests.yml` had that `ci.yml` didn't).

`lint.yml` (from PR #127) is untouched.

## Side-by-side diff summary

| Aspect | `ci.yml` (before) | `tests.yml` (before) | Consolidated `ci.yml` (after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trigger | `push` to main + `pull_request` to main | `pull_request` (any branch) | `push` to main + `pull_request` to main (ci.yml wins) |
| OS matrix | `ubuntu-latest`, `macos-latest` | `ubuntu-latest` only | `ubuntu-latest`, `macos-latest` (ci.yml wins) |
| Python matrix | `3.10`, `3.11`, `3.12` | `3.10`, `3.11`, `3.12` | `3.10`, `3.11`, `3.12` (identical) |
| Total jobs | 6 | 3 | 6 |
| Install command | `pip install -e ".[all,dev]"` | `pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install -r requirements-test.txt && pip install -e .` | `pip install -e ".[all,dev]"` (ci.yml wins) |
| pip cache | none | `cache: pip` with `requirements*.txt` | `cache: pip` with `pyproject.toml` (tests.yml wins, adapted) |
| Test command | `pytest --tb=short -q` | `pytest` | `pytest --tb=short -q` (ci.yml wins) |
| Import smoke check | yes | no | yes (ci.yml wins) |

## What was duplicate
Both workflows ran `pytest` against Python 3.10/3.11/3.12 on Ubuntu. Those 3 Ubuntu jobs were genuinely redundant.

## What was unique to each
- `ci.yml`: macOS coverage, push-to-main trigger, import smoke check, `.[all,dev]` install (uses `pyproject.toml` as the dependency source of truth).
- `tests.yml`: pip caching, `requirements*.txt` install path.

## What wins
`ci.yml` is the survivor because it already had broader OS coverage and the push-to-main trigger. The one feature borrowed from `tests.yml` is pip caching (now keyed on `pyproject.toml` since the install is `pip install -e ".[all,dev]"`, not `requirements.txt`).

## Expected check count on future PRs
- Before: 9 pytest jobs (6 from `ci.yml` + 3 from `tests.yml`) + 1 lint job = 10 checks.
- After: 6 pytest jobs + 1 lint job = 7 checks. CI minutes on the Ubuntu lane are roughly halved.

## Notes / out of scope for this PR
The issue body also proposes (a) adding `windows-latest` to the matrix, (b) collapsing `.[all,dev]` to `.[dev]`, and (c) documenting the canonical install in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Those are separable concerns and not required to resolve the duplicate-workflow problem; leaving them for a follow-up keeps this PR a pure consolidation with no behavioral change beyond removing the duplicate Ubuntu jobs and enabling pip caching.

## Verification
- `python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))"` parses cleanly.
- No README badge or doc references to `tests.yml` were found, so nothing else needed updating.

author: bzantium
body:
# What does this PR do ?

Three call sites in the codebase still invoked `AutoConfig.from_pretrained` without `trust_remote_code=True`. This crashes for any model that ships custom modeling code via `auto_map` in `config.json`, since `transformers` then tries to interactively prompt the user, which raises `EOFError` inside a Ray worker (stdin is closed) and finally surfaces the underlying `ValueError`:

```
ValueError: The repository <path> contains custom code which must be executed
to correctly load the model. ... Please pass the argument
`trust_remote_code=True` to allow custom code to be run.
```

The rest of the codebase already passes `trust_remote_code=True` at every other `from_pretrained` site (`flops_tracker.py`, `native_checkpoint.py`, `sglang_worker.py`, `vllm_worker.py`, `dtensor_policy_worker.py`, `automodel/setup.py`, `huggingface/common.py`, `megatron/setup.py`, `megatron/community_import.py`, `algorithms/utils.py`), so this PR just restores consistency at the three remaining sites.

Patched sites:

| File | Function | Why it crashes |
|---|---|---|
| `nemo_rl/algorithms/distillation.py` | `check_vocab_equality` | Probes student and teacher configs at setup. The crash is fatal because it happens before any model weights are loaded, so distillation is fully blocked for any custom-arch student or teacher. |
| `nemo_rl/models/generation/vllm/quantization/fp8.py` | `init_fp8` | Probes the model config to decide FP8 quant plumbing for vLLM. |
| `nemo_rl/models/megatron/draft/utils.py` | `build_draft_model` | Probes the draft model config for Megatron speculative decoding. |

The `distillation.py` site is the one I actually hit in practice (on-policy distillation with a custom-arch HF student that ships `modeling_*.py` and `configuration_*.py` via `auto_map`). The other two are the same precondition violation in lower-traffic paths and were caught while looking at the surrounding `AutoConfig.from_pretrained` usages.

# Issues

None filed; this is a small consistency fix discovered while debugging a custom-arch distillation run.

# Usage

No new API or configuration. After this patch a distillation run with a custom-arch student or teacher, e.g.

```yaml
policy:
  model_name: /path/to/custom-arch-student   # config.json has auto_map.AutoModelForCausalLM
distillation:
  teacher:
    model_name: /path/to/custom-arch-teacher
```

proceeds past `check_vocab_equality` instead of dying at setup.

author: getogrand
body:
## Summary
This PR stabilizes the Cost submenu in the CodexBar menu. The user-visible issue was that hovering or clicking the `Cost` row usually did not open the submenu, even though the submenu data existed. In some timing windows it did open, which pointed to an AppKit menu tracking problem rather than a missing-data problem.

The fix keeps the actual behavior narrow: make the Cost row a native AppKit submenu item, hydrate chart submenus before AppKit starts submenu tracking, and stop ordinary data refreshes from rebuilding the parent menu while it is already open.

## User-facing problem
Before this change, the Cost submenu was unreliable from the user perspective:

- Opening the CodexBar menu and hovering over `Cost` usually did not show the right-side submenu.
- Clicking `Cost` also usually failed to open the submenu.
- The row sometimes appeared to lose focus while the pointer was on it.
- The submenu could appear occasionally, which made the bug feel intermittent and timing-dependent.

This was especially confusing because the Cost row itself rendered correctly and the underlying Cost history data was available. The broken part was the handoff from the parent menu row to the submenu.

## Root cause
The failure came from a combination of three AppKit-hosted menu behaviors.

### 1. The Cost row was view-backed instead of a native submenu row
The Cost row used a SwiftUI-backed menu card view with a submenu attached to the containing `NSMenuItem`. AppKit can support view-backed menu items, but submenu hover/click tracking is more fragile than with a plain native `NSMenuItem`.

For this particular row, AppKit had to track a submenu through a custom hosted view instead of a standard menu item title/subtitle row. That made the submenu handoff easier to interrupt when anything else changed in the menu.

### 2. The parent menu could rebuild while it was open
The menu refresh path allowed ordinary store/dashboard/token refreshes to repopulate an already-open parent menu. When that happened near a hover or click on `Cost`, the original menu item could be replaced before AppKit completed submenu tracking.

That explains the intermittent behavior: if no refresh/rebuild landed during the hover/click window, the submenu could open. If a rebuild landed during that window, AppKit lost the item it was tracking and the submenu did not appear.

### 3. Hosted chart submenus were hydrated lazily
Hosted chart submenus were represented by a placeholder item and hydrated when the submenu opened. That meant submenu contents changed right as AppKit was trying to open and measure the submenu. The placeholder/chart items were also not consistently enabled.

That extra mutation made submenu opening less deterministic, especially when combined with the parent menu rebuild issue.

## Fix details

### 1. Use a native AppKit item for Cost
The Cost row now uses a plain `NSMenuItem(title: "Cost", ...)` with its submenu attached directly to `item.submenu`. This lets AppKit own the normal submenu hover and click behavior for the row.

The visible Cost details are still preserved through the item tooltip and macOS 14.4+ subtitle support, but the row no longer depends on SwiftUI view-backed menu tracking.

### 2. Pre-hydrate hosted chart submenus when width is known
Hosted chart submenus now support a `makeHydratedHostedSubviewMenu(...)` path. When the parent menu already knows its rendered width, the submenu is built with the real hosted chart item immediately instead of waiting until `menuWillOpen`.

This reduces mutation during AppKit submenu opening and gives the chart view a stable width before the submenu is displayed.

### 3. Keep hosted submenu items enabled
The placeholder and hydrated chart items are now enabled. The unavailable-data fallback remains disabled, because that is a real non-interactive empty state.

This avoids putting disabled placeholder/chart rows in the submenu path AppKit needs to open and display.

### 4. Defer ordinary parent menu rebuilds while open
Open-menu refresh now has two paths:

- Ordinary data refreshes update menu content versions but do not rebuild the open parent menu. The latest data is picked up the next time the parent menu opens.
- Structure changes, such as provider switcher changes, can still rebuild an open parent menu when needed.

This prevents background data refreshes from replacing the `Cost` item while AppKit is tracking hover/click interaction. At the same time, provider switcher behavior remains responsive when the menu structure actually needs to change.

### 5. Avoid parent rebuilds while hosted submenus are open
If a hosted submenu is already open, parent menu rebuilds are skipped. Hosted submenu height refresh still runs for the submenu itself. This keeps the parent menu stable during submenu interaction.

## Regression coverage
This PR adds/updates focused coverage for the failure mode:

- Verifies that the Cost row is now a native item rather than a view-backed menu item.
- Verifies that the Cost submenu is pre-hydrated with the Cost history chart item.
- Verifies that ordinary data refreshes do not rebuild the open parent menu.
- Verifies that the parent menu refreshes when it is closed and opened again.
- Preserves coverage that provider switcher structure changes can still rebuild stale switcher rows.

## Cleanup
While debugging, extra diagnostic logging and hover-tracking experiments were useful to identify the timing issue. Those were removed before this PR was finalized. The final patch only keeps the code needed for the actual fix.

Removed from the final patch:

- Temporary menu open/close/highlight diagnostics.
- Temporary hover-tracking workaround state.
- Temporary `hydrateHostedSubviewMenu` debug logging.
- Tests that only covered the temporary workaround.

## Validation
- `swift build`
- `swift test --filter StatusMenuHostedSubmenuRefreshTests && swift test --filter StatusMenuTests && swift test --filter StatusMenuSwitcherRefreshTests && make check`
- `swift test`

Full test result: 2342 tests in 292 suites passed.

## Local packaging note
I also attempted `./Scripts/package_app.sh` to refresh the local app bundle. The production build completed, but the script stopped at codesigning because this machine does not have the configured Developer ID identity:

`Developer ID Application: Peter Steinberger (Y5PE65HELJ): no identity found`

I did not ad-hoc re-sign the app as a workaround, because changing signing identity can affect macOS TCC permissions.

body:
## Summary

Fixes the VPZONE source — both the standalone WebSocket dock (\`sources/websocket/vpzone.js\`) and the on-page extension content script (\`sources/vpzone.js\`). When testing against \`vpzone.tv/watch/<channel>\` with the dev backend on \`chat.nexus-7.vpzone.tv\`, the source had four observable symptoms:

1. **Avatars never rendered** in the dock — VPZONE WS frames don't carry an avatar URL.
2. **Follow / sub / raid / gift / clip events** either didn't surface or surfaced under their raw type instead of a mapped event name.
3. **Every chat row attributed to "VPZone"** when the underlying frame didn't have a username (or had \`username: "system"\`).
4. **Each message arrived twice** in the dashboard while the extension was loaded on \`vpzone.tv\`: the WS interceptor and the DOM scraper both fired for every line.

Plus an unrelated annoyance: the dock kept hitting a 4-second reconnect loop after the server closed with a 1008 (e.g. banned account), because the existing handler only recognized \`"bad channel"\` as terminal.

## Changes

### \`sources/websocket/vpzone.js\` (standalone dock)
- **\`fetchAvatar(username)\`** hits \`/api/chat/profile-card/{username}\` (the unauthenticated, CDN-cached endpoint). Result is cached per username; negative lookups are remembered for 5 min (404 / no profile) or 1 min (network error). \`handleEvent\` enriches the frame with the resolved avatar before building the outgoing payload so the very first message from a chatter ships with an avatar — subsequent ones hit the cache synchronously.
  - Falls through \`fetchJson()\` which routes to the background \`vpzoneFetchJson\` handler when direct fetch is blocked by CORS — works for both the file-loaded dock and the extension-loaded variant.
- **\`mapEventName\`** gets explicit cases for \`raid\`, \`gift\` → \`gift_subscription\`, \`clip\`, \`level_up\`.
- **\`buildChat\` / \`buildEvent\`** return \`null\` when no real actor can be extracted instead of falling back to \`SOURCE_NAME\` / \`"VPZone User"\`. Fixes the "every row shows VPZone" symptom on system frames.
- **\`liftSystemActor\`** promotes \`metadata.username\` to the canonical actor for system frames whose \`metadata.kind\` identifies a real user (\`level_up\`, future kinds). \`isJoinAnnouncement\` drops the chat-server's "X just joined" rows that carry no real actor.
- **\`onclose\` 1008** now treats every policy-violation close as terminal (not just \`"bad channel"\`), distinguishes \`banned\` vs. \`bad channel\` vs. generic 1008 in the status text, and prevents the 4 s reconnect spam.

### \`sources/vpzone.js\` (extension content script)
- **\`wsCaptureActive\` flag** is set on the first WS frame received from the page-injected interceptor. \`handleRow\` short-circuits the DOM-scraper emit path once the flag is set, so each message ships once. Flag resets on SPA URL change so a fresh channel re-detects.
- **\`follow\`/\`subscription\`/\`raid\`/\`gift\`/\`clip\`** branch consolidated; actor falls back to \`metadata.username\` when the top-level \`username\` is missing or hard-coded to \`"system"\`. Avatar is enriched from the existing \`avatarCache\` (with a kicked-off background fetch on first sight).
- **\`system\`** branch drops bare join announcements (no \`metadata.kind\`), lifts \`metadata.username\` for \`level_up\`-style frames, and enriches with the resolved actor's avatar instead of attributing to \`"system"\`.

### \`manifest.json\`
- Adds \`https://*.vpzone.tv/*\` to both \`content_scripts\` entries and \`host_permissions\` so the extension also loads on dev subdomains (e.g. \`nexus-7.vpzone.tv\`). The apex \`vpzone.tv\` and \`www.vpzone.tv\` continue to be matched explicitly.

## Test plan

- [x] Load unpacked extension, open \`https://vpzone.tv/watch/<live-channel>\`
- [x] Console shows both inject and content-script init logs
- [x] Sending a chat message produces exactly one row in the dashboard (was two before)
- [x] Follow / sub / raid events appear with the real actor (was \`"VPZone"\` / \`"system"\` before)
- [x] Avatars resolve on first sight in both the dock and the on-page extension
- [x] Banning the test account closes the dock with a meaningful status instead of hammering reconnects
- [x] \`node --check\` passes on all three touched JS files; \`JSON.parse\` passes on the manifest

## Summary
- Closes the agentmemory point-1 loop: when a Cursor chat is bound to a role, helm scans every agent response asynchronously and surfaces role-relevant segments as **candidates** for the user to Accept / Reject / Edit. No more manual copy-paste-then-train-role to fold in knowledge the agent just produced live.
- Built on the two earlier phases — multipath retrieval (PR #76) gave us the entity index + cosine surface this leans on, lifecycle (PR #77) gave us the soft-archive that the scorer respects.

## How it hangs together
1. `host_agent_response` → fire-and-forget `captureFromAgentResponse`
2. Splitter peels prose + fenced code (≥80 chars min on prose; code bypasses floor)
3. Per segment × per bound role, scorer runs entity-overlap + cosine **in parallel**, OR'd
4. Qualifying segments → `knowledge_candidates` (migration v15, partial unique index dedups by `text_hash` while pending or rejected)
5. Roles UI gains a Candidates tab + `(N) new` badge on each role
6. Accept routes through Phase 66 conflict detection in `update_role` — accepting near-duplicates still asks the user to pick keep/replace

## What's deliberately NOT exposed
- No MCP mutating tools for accept / reject / edit (only `list_role_candidates` read-only) — prevents agents from auto-approving knowledge they themselves produced.
- Reject is terminal at the DB level (partial unique index covers pending OR rejected) — won't be re-suggested.

## Reviewer-fix pass
Independent review caught two blockers and several should-fixes, all addressed in this PR:
- `insertCandidateIfNew` now narrows its catch to `SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE` only — FK violations surface, the orchestrator logs `capture_role_gone` and continues the sweep instead of silently dropping the candidate.
- Scorer entity leg no longer disagrees with cosine leg about archived chunks (both now treat cold knowledge as "known").
- `segmentEntities` capped at 64 (DoS-shaped huge-entity-set bounded).
- `/api/roles/:id/candidates?status=…` validates the param and 400s on typos instead of silently returning `[]`.
- Dedup e2e tightened from count-equality to id-set equality.

## Test plan
- [x] `pnpm typecheck` clean
- [x] `pnpm test` — 1299 passed (+39 vs PR #78 baseline)
- [x] `pnpm test:e2e` — 160 passed (+7 vs PR #78 baseline)
- [x] Migration v15 schema verified via the new repo round-trip + FK cascade tests
- [x] Partial unique index behavior pinned (re-insert while pending or rejected → `false`; accepted → re-insertable)
- [ ] Manual smoke: bind a role to a chat, watch an agent response, see candidate appear → Accept → chunk count grows

The previous implementation of the bidirectional tunnel relied on one of the fibers being able to close the other fibers socket. This would occasionally cause a fatal assert in vibe-core net.d:768. 
It is impossible to implement this correctly with out exposing waitForDataEx to allow distinguishing between data arriving, end of data and timeout. The timeout allows checking to see if the other pipe has been closed.
This way each fiber closes its own socket naturally, avoiding a race condition that can crash your server.

💡 What: Modified the `MutationObserver` callback in the content scripts (`content.ts` and `content.js`) to use a more specific CSS selector (`a:not([data-vault-scanned])`). Added logic to tag processed anchor tags with `data-vault-scanned` and to clear this attribute whenever the cached vault data changes.

🎯 Why: Previously, on every DOM mutation, the content script would query every single `<a>` tag on the page and loop through them to check if their `href` was in the `cachedSavedUrls` set. On pages with infinite scrolling or a large number of links, this created a massive O(N) performance bottleneck, causing main-thread blocking and scroll jank.

📊 Impact: Reduces repetitive DOM and JavaScript iteration overhead from O(N) (total links on page) to O(new_links) (new links added since the last mutation). This is an expected ~90-99% reduction in loop iterations during standard scrolling on heavy pages like YouTube or Reddit.

🔬 Measurement: Run a performance profile while scrolling rapidly on an infinite-scroll page with the extension enabled. Observe the drastically reduced scripting time spent inside the `highlightVaultItems` function compared to the main branch. Run `npx vitest run src` to confirm tests continue to pass.

## Summary

- `packages/shared/src/__tests__/type-contracts.spec.ts` を追加し、`@ubm-hyogo/shared` public barrel 経由で brand 型・view-model schema・admin body schema の compile-time 型契約を 5 describe / 15 it（AC-1..AC-5）で固定。
- UT-08A-05 source spec を `unassigned-task` から `completed-tasks` へ移動し、Issue #324 を `implemented_local_evidence_captured / implementation / NON_VISUAL` として skill 群（changelog / quick-reference / resource-map / task-workflow-active / 08a artifact inventory / LOGS）と同 wave で同期。
- typecheck / lint / test（18 files / 210 tests PASS）を Phase 11 evidence として `outputs/phase-11/evidence/` に格納。

## Implementation Guide（Part 1: 中学生レベル）

会員 ID、回答 ID、メールアドレスは見た目はぜんぶ文字なので、人がうっかり別の箱に入れても何も確認しない仕組みだと通ってしまう。学校の下駄箱で「1 年 A 組の鍵」と「体育館の鍵」がどちらも金属だから同じものとして扱われるようなもの。鍵穴の形を先に決めておけば、違う鍵は差した瞬間に止まる。本作業では `packages/shared` に「この鍵はこの鍵穴だけ」という検査表を追加した。会員 ID とメールアドレスを取り違えたら、プログラムを動かす前に赤くなる。

### 用語の言い換え

| 用語 | 日常語での言い換え |
| --- | --- |
| 型 | 入れ物の形 |
| brand 型 | 名前付きの専用鍵 |
| schema | データの設計図 |
| compile-time | 動かす前の確認時間 |
| `@ts-expect-error` | ここは間違いとして止まるべき、という目印 |

## Implementation Guide（Part 2: 技術者レベル）

### 型定義

- `Brand<T, B>` / `MemberId` / `ResponseId` / `ResponseEmail` / `AdminId`: `packages/shared/src/branded/index.ts`
- view-model schema: `MemberProfileZ`, `PublicMemberListViewZ`, `PublicMemberProfileZ`, `AdminMemberListViewZ`, `AdminMemberDetailViewZ`, `AdminDashboardViewZ`
- admin body schema: `adminRequestResolveBodySchema`, `AdminRequestResolveBody`

### API / assertion

```ts
expectTypeOf<ResponseEmail>().not.toMatchTypeOf<ResponseId>();
expectTypeOf<z.input<typeof MemberProfileZ>>().toEqualTypeOf<
  z.output<typeof MemberProfileZ>
>();
// @ts-expect-error: memberId is required on MemberProfile.
const viewModel: z.infer<typeof MemberProfileZ> = { ... };
```

### 使用例

実装は `packages/shared/src/__tests__/type-contracts.spec.ts`。`@ubm-hyogo/shared` public barrel から import し、5 describe / 15 it で AC-1..AC-5 と公開 export 面を固定する。

### エラー処理

`@ts-expect-error` が不要になった場合、`tsc --noEmit` が `Unused @ts-expect-error directive` で失敗する。これにより必須 field 欠落や型混入の検出力が失われた場合に CI で検知できる。

### 設定値

| 項目 | 方針 |
| --- | --- |
| test filename | `*.spec.ts` |
| runner | 既存 vitest |
| type gate | 既存 `tsc --noEmit` |
| 追加 dependency | なし |
| 不採用 | `tsd`, vitest typecheck mode |

### スクリーンショット境界

本タスクは `visualEvidence=NON_VISUAL` で、UI / route / CSS / runtime 画面を変更していない。Phase 11 の証跡は `shared-typecheck.txt` / `shared-lint.txt` / `shared-test.txt` の 3 ファイルで足りるため、スクリーンショットは不要。

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm install --force`
- [x] `pnpm typecheck`
- [x] `pnpm lint`
- [x] `packages/shared/src/__tests__/type-contracts.spec.ts` を含む 18 files / 210 tests PASS（Phase 11 evidence）

今回 PR #83 で `nskk` の ref を更新した際にこのパスを踏み、`elpaca-update-all` が継続的にエラーを返す状態になっていた。

author: amityadavvoid-ui
body:
💡 What: Refactored the `ui.js` particle system to rely on a single, centralized `requestAnimationFrame` loop that efficiently updates all active particle states using a reverse `while (i--)` loop instead of generating a concurrent `requestAnimationFrame` for every spawned DOM node. Also fixed state leaks when re-initializing the system. 
🎯 Why: Creating individual animation loops per DOM element is a severe anti-pattern that heavily taxes the CPU and results in high garbage collection overhead, leading to frame drops. This optimization dramatically stabilizes the framerate during active particle emission.
📊 Impact: Reduces `requestAnimationFrame` concurrency from O(n) (where n is active particles up to 25) down to O(1), saving CPU cycles and heavily reducing JS function closures per frame.
🔬 Measurement: Verified visually using the existing `verification/verify.py` test suite against the local server to ensure identical animation behavior while significantly reducing closure count and garbage collection pressure in the background.

### Motivation
- Add support for routing requests to multiple upstream Mockoon or other services and allow per-route interception rules. 
- Provide SSE-style streaming for intercepted endpoints with an optional inter-line delay to emulate chunked/streaming responses. 
- Allow running the proxy as a background daemon with simple start/stop/status scripts and logging. 

### Description
- Implemented route-based configuration in `src/index.js` with `routes`, `matchPaths`, and `interceptPaths`, and preserved backward compatibility for `targetBaseUrl` and single `interceptPath`/`interceptPaths`. 
- Added path normalization helpers, `pickRoute` longest-prefix matching, and per-request routing so each request is proxied to the correct `targetBaseUrl`. 
- Enhanced SSE handling to stream lines parsed by `\r?\n`, emit `text/event-stream` headers, and optionally delay between lines via `streamDelayMs`; added `sleep` and `writeSseLine` helpers. 
- Added daemon scripts `scripts/start.sh` and `scripts/stop.sh`, log/pid file handling under `logs/`, and new npm scripts `start:daemon`, `stop:daemon`, and `status:daemon`; updated `README.md` and `config.json` examples and docs.

author: brent-mills-engineering
body:
## Summary

Establishes a repo-wide working model for development as the repo opens up to more engineers and more AI agents. Three pillars, plus git conventions:

- **Shared lexicon (DDD)**: one global glossary as the single source of truth for domain terms, with a deprecated-term map so history stays readable without rewriting it. The glossary supersedes all other docs and code, save for reality.
- **TDD**: failing test -> code until green -> commit the block -> push. Tests assert behavior, not implementation. Existing tests may not be edited silently; changes are flagged to the engineer for approval.
- **Spec-driven development**: the grilling protocol builds agreed understanding (intent, edges, failure modes) before any code. The spec is local-only, single-engineer scaffolding and is discarded; the tests it produces are the durable artifact.

New files in `ai_guides/`: `README.md` (index), `glossary.md`, `domain-language.md`, `tdd.md`, `grilling-protocol.md`, `spec-format.md`, `git-conventions.md`.

Thin pointer files redirect each tool to `ai_guides/README.md` as the single source of truth: `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.cursor/rules/ai-guides.mdc`.

Supporting changes:
- `.gitignore`: untrack `CLAUDE.md` so the pointer can be committed; ignore `local/` for disposable specs.
- `.github/CODEOWNERS`: explicit `/ai_guides/` ownership line for documented intent.

## Notes / open items

- **Glossary is unpopulated.** Terms were intentionally not invented. The domain owner populates it.
- **CODEOWNERS handle**: existing `*` rule uses `@not-that-guy-again`; `gh` reports the authed user as `brent-mills-engineering`. Matched the existing file. Correct if wrong.
- **`documentation/` -> `local/`**: standard going forward is `local/`. Both are gitignored; migrate when convenient.
- Vulcan (honesty/succinctness) was scoped out as personal, not a repo doc.

## Test plan

- [ ] Confirm the three pointer files load in their respective tools and redirect to `ai_guides/README.md`.
- [ ] Confirm CODEOWNERS gates `ai_guides/` changes on the branch ruleset.
- [ ] Review guide content for accuracy against intent.

author: jaimecernuda
body:
Part of #30.

Adds `.github/workflows/release.yml`: on a `v*` tag push, builds the sdist + wheel with `uv build` and publishes to PyPI with `uv publish` via **Trusted Publishing (OIDC)** -- no API token secret stored in the repo. Guards that the git tag matches the `pyproject.toml` version.

**One-time PyPI setup** (also in the workflow header): on the PyPI `clio-agent` project, register `iowarp/clio-agent` + `release.yml` + the `pypi` environment as a trusted publisher. If the project doesn't exist yet, create it (or do the first upload manually with a token, then switch to OIDC).

This is the clio-agent half of "prebuilt releases" -- end users then `pip/uv install clio-agent` instead of cloning and building.

Still open under #30, deliberately not in this PR:
- the **gact-tui binary build workflow** -- separate repo (tracked as its own task)
- the **install.sh / install.ps1 rewrite** to download released artifacts instead of clone-and-build -- needs an actual published release to test against, so it's a genuine follow-up, not a skip
